trends.name: Merrymaxxing (rhinestones, crystals, bold colour)
trends.what: Festive maximalism: rhinestones, gemstones, bold colour and personality-filled ornaments for party season.
trends.evidence: Etsy's Seller Trend Report: Fall and Winter 2026 names Merrymaxxing as the lead trend — 'More is the mood this season. Rhinestones, gemstones, bold color, and ornaments with personality are taking center stage' — plus Craftmas. eRank's holiday 2026 guide frames the season as 'Frosted, Festive & Unexpected' with a Classic Heritage strand (tartan, velvet). TikTok's Trendy Jewelry hub (updated 2026-10-19) shows creators like @shopzoila pushing chunky silver statement necklaces, beaded necklaces and bold statement earrings. Ellison Young's holiday 2026 guide leads entirely with Christmas tree and statement earrings.
trends.idea: Front a 'merrymaxxing' party-season edit built on the rhinestone chokers and crystal bead stacks, bundled as layered sets.

trends.name: Chunky collars and torque chokers
trends.what: Big, rigid statement necklaces replacing layered dainty chains at the neckline.
trends.evidence: Who What Wear's FW26 jewellery report: 'From Chanel to Chloé, models wore large, chunky necklaces that made a major statement. Long gone are the days of dainty chains layered on top of one another'. Its luxury 2026 piece names torque chokers and arm cuffs among the four leading luxury trends, citing Zoë Kravitz's Jessica McCormack arm cuff. Branvas' 2026 Jewelry Trend Map, built on Google Trends plus member brand sales data, notes 'the minimalism wave that dominated 2022-2023 visibly cooling'.
missing: chunky curb or cable statement chains
trends.idea: Push the heaviest-looking existing chokers as the chunky-neckline answer while sampling a rigid collar.

trends.name: Celestial: stars, moons, constellations
trends.what: Star, moon and constellation motifs taking over from snowflakes as the holiday jewellery story.
trends.evidence: eRank's Top 2026 Holiday Trends for Etsy Sellers: 'Snowflakes and winter forests are giving way to stars, moons, constellations'. National Jeweler's coverage of Pinterest Predicts 2026 'Extra Celestial' reports 'Searches for the word "opalescent" are up 115 percent, and searches for "alien core aesthetic" are up 80 percent'. Who What Wear lists Extra Celestial among the five Pinterest 2026 predictions it expects to last.
trends.idea: Group the star and zodiac pieces into a celestial gifting collection for December–January.

trends.name: Silver-toned jewellery for AW
trends.what: Silver tones returning as the dominant metal for autumn/winter 2026.
trends.evidence: PORTER / Net-a-Porter's fall 2026 trend report (26 Aug '26) opens with 'Silver-toned jewelry is back in fashion for fall/winter 2026', alongside ocean-inspired designs and supersized beads. TikTok creator round-ups for fall 2026 lead with chunky silver statement necklaces.
trends.idea: Run a silver-forward winter edit across body chains and glasses chains.

trends.name: Maximalist pearls
trends.what: Pearlcore going mainstream, worn big and layered rather than demure.
trends.evidence: Branvas' 2026 Jewelry Trend Map 'uses Google Trends and sales data to show which jewelry styles are rising, cooling, or worth betting on' and reports 'pearlcore accelerating into mainstream, chunky gold holding strong'. Vogue Adria's AW26/27 report names 'Long necklaces, maximalist pearls and vintage earrings' as the season's defining pieces.
trends.idea: Merchandise pearls as stacked multi-piece looks to read maximalist despite dainty scale.

trends.name: Charms and personalisation as collectible gifting
trends.what: Meaningful, personalised and charm-based pieces bought as collections that invite repeat purchase.
trends.evidence: Stuller's 6 Biggest Holiday Jewelry Trends for 2026: 'A shopper can give one meaningful piece today while creating an easy reason to return for the next addition — whether it's for a birthday, anniversary, graduation, vacation, or another milestone'. eRank says Etsy shoppers are 'leaning toward warmth, nostalgia, and personalized pieces with meaning, such as engraved jewelry'.
trends.idea: Sell personalised pieces as start-a-collection gifts with a clear 'add the next one' follow-up.

trends.name: Category gaps: earrings, brooches, bows, cuffs, tassels, vamp romantic
trends.what: Named 2026 trends the shop cannot serve at all with current stock.
trends.evidence: Glimpse's Google Trends product list puts flat back earrings at 65% YoY growth; Ellison Young and TikTok fall round-ups make statement earrings the holiday hero. Pinterest Predicts 2026's 'Brooched' trend is reported by National Jeweler and called Who What Wear's #1 pick of 21 predictions. Yahoo Finance notes 'The bow and ribbon motifs that have spread across consumer categories since 2024'. Who What Wear's luxury 2026 piece names arm cuffs; its 2026 jewellery trends piece names tassels. Pinterest's own Vamp Romantic page describes 'an after-dark aesthetic, embracing jet black nails, romantic goth hairstyles'. Social Media Today notes Pinterest has '88% of its predictions going on to become bigger trends', and The Jewellery Gossip reports 'Online sentiment for fall fashion is around 23% higher versus the same time last year'.
trends.idea: Prioritise a small earrings sampling run, then bows/ribbon and moon-constellation charms since chain-making skills transfer directly.

blogIdeas.query: what jewellery to wear with a satin slip dress
blogIdeas.why: Who What Wear's FW26 report says chunky collars and chokers are replacing layered dainty chains, which is exactly the styling tension on a thin satin strap during party season.

blogIdeas.query: jewellery gifts for the woman who has everything
blogIdeas.why: eRank's holiday 2026 report is titled 'Frosted, Festive & Unexpected' and Stuller frames the winning gift as one meaningful piece that starts a collection.
Stuller and eRank both put personalised, engraved and charm pieces at the top of holiday demand, and 'wife' is the missing recipient in the Christmas series.
eRank reports stars, moons and constellations replacing snowflakes this holiday, and National Jeweler's Pinterest Predicts coverage shows opalescent searches up 115%.
Stuller's holiday 2026 charm logic — one meaningful piece that creates a reason to return — plus eRank's read on personalised pieces with meaning.

trends.name: Insect/nature motifs
trends.what: Bug-themed jewelry, especially dragonflies, beetles, and bees, is surging as a nature motif for 2026.
trends.evidence: Pinterest's 2026 forecast reports bug jewelry searches up 60 percent (FineColorJewels.com, covering Pinterest's official 2026 Predicts report); National Jeweler also covered the same report.
trends.idea: Promote the dragonfly pieces as part of the rising insect-motif trend.

trends.name: Brooch revival
trends.what: Brooches and pins are seeing a major resurgence as a styling accessory for 2026.
trends.evidence: National Jeweler's Pinterest-trend recap states searches for 'brooch aesthetic' are up 110 percent, naming it one of six major jewelry directions for 2026.
trends.idea: No action possible; this is a category Bodystrands does not stock.

trends.name: Icy blue / aquamarine color trend
trends.what: An icy, aquamarine-toned blue color palette is trending across jewelry for 2026, dubbed 'Extra Celestial'.
trends.evidence: JCK's writeup of Pinterest's 2026 report notes Gen Z and millennials are interested in 'an icy shade of blue,' advising jewelers to stock aquamarine.
trends.idea: Feature the turquoise/icy-blue beaded collection as on-trend for the 2026 color forecast.

trends.name: Anklet stacking
trends.what: Wearing multiple anklets layered together as a styling 'uniform' is trending for foot jewelry.
trends.evidence: WhoWhatWear's seasonal trend piece observes stylists wearing 'multiple anklets, in fact—like a uniform,' and a separate comeback article credits social platforms for fueling the trend.
trends.idea: Create a styling guide showing how to layer multiple anklets and barefoot sandals together.

trends.name: Fashion-forward glasses chains
trends.what: Glasses chains are moving from practical accessory to fashion statement, driven by Gen Z adoption.
trends.evidence: MiaBurton's 2026 eyewear trend report states glasses chains are 'emerging as 2026's must-have accessory,' and EZContacts frames it as a Gen Z-led revival.
trends.idea: Launch blog content targeting the glasses chain trend since the catalog is strong but content coverage is currently zero.

trends.name: Hair accessory diversification
trends.what: Hair clips, combs, pins, and headbands (seashell clips, tortoiseshell headbands, French pins) are trending for 2026.
trends.evidence: WhoWhatWear's recurring 2026 hair-accessory coverage highlights seashell clips, tortoiseshell headbands, and French pins as ongoing seasonal trends.
trends.idea: No direct product match; our chain-based hair pieces are a different format from the trending clips/pins/headbands.

blogIdeas.why: Glasses chains are being called 2026's must-have accessory by eyewear press, and EZContacts frames it as a Gen Z revival.
WhoWhatWear describes stylists stacking multiple anklets like a uniform, with social platforms fueling the trend.
Pinterest's 2026 report found bug jewelry searches up 60 percent, a fresh motif wave for jewelry.
Mainstream gift roundups and Etsy's standing Galentine Jewelry Gift market page show demand for friend-gifting ahead of Valentine's Day.
Active 2026 Jewelry Advent Calendar listings on Amazon show sustained shopper demand for countdown gift sets.

trends.name: Silver over gold
trends.what: Silver-toned jewellery is replacing gold as the dominant metal for AW26, pushed by runway shows and record gold prices.
trends.evidence: HELLO! Magazine frames silver as the comeback style of 2026, tied to silver's record price. Woman & Home names 'sculptural silver' as trend #1 citing Ralph Lauren and Bottega Veneta SS26. NET-A-PORTER's PORTER (Aug 2026) states silver-toned jewellery is back for fall/winter 2026. Second-hand: Artizan Joyeria, citing Google Trends, says US silver jewellery searches are up 60% vs the previous five years, 2026 the highest; The Locket Sisters repeats that figure and adds gold passed $5,000/oz in January 2026, with Bottega Veneta, Chanel and Givenchy showing bold silver for Spring 2026.
trends.idea: Push the €20–€30 silver pieces as the hero gift price point while gold prices scare shoppers.

trends.name: Charm-led sentimental jewellery
trends.what: Charms, charm bracelets and charm necklaces carrying personal meaning are a dominant gifting trend.
trends.evidence: Lily Charmed reports Marie Claire UK's 2026 trend report citing a 136% rise in NET-A-PORTER searches for charm bracelets. Our Coordinates cites Google's April 2026 spring fashion/beauty search report: 'chunky necklace' at an all-time high and 'chunky charm necklace' nearly doubling in one month. AB Designs claims bag-charm Google searches +168% and Pinterest saves +700%. Stuller's holiday report (15 Oct 2026) lists charms and personalised pendants among the six biggest holiday 2026 trends. Who What Wear backs 'grown-up charms'. Percentage figures are second-hand via retailer blogs.
trends.idea: Merchandise finished charm pieces as a sentimental gift edit while exploring a clasp-on charm range.

trends.name: Holiday maximalism
trends.what: Rhinestones, bold colour, ornate vintage-feeling statement pieces for party season.
trends.evidence: Etsy's Seller Trend Report: Fall and Winter 2026 (~16 Oct 2026) names 'Merrymaxxing' (rhinestones, gemstones, bold colour) and 'Operatic Drama' (ornate brooches, capelets, vintage jewellery) as on the rise. Mark Schneider Design (Sept 2026) says fall/winter 2026 moves away from minimalism toward bold necklaces, brooches and pearls. Pinterest Predicts 2026, via JCK, says jewellery gets 'chunkier, bolder, and golder'. National Jeweler reports 'brooch aesthetic' searches up 110%; Fine Color Jewels cites maximalist accessories +105%, gold cuff +50%, heirloom jewellery +45%.
trends.idea: Build a party-season maximalist edit around the rhinestone chokers and layered stacks.

trends.name: Tassels and fringe
trends.what: Tassel and chain-fringe details, especially on long necklaces and in black, are returning as a 2026 trend.
trends.evidence: Who What Wear lists 'Tasseled Details' as one of six trends defining 2026, noting movement and drama especially in black, and separately named 'The Return of Tassels' in its summer 2026 list. Fashionista ties tassels to the inflation-driven shift to non-metal materials, seen mostly in necklaces. WorthPoint confirms the revival, focused on long necklaces and chain tassels.
trends.idea: Develop a chain-fringe back chain as the handmade signature version of the tassel trend.

trends.name: Cuffs, bangles and rigid metal
trends.what: Sculptural cuffs, bangles and rigid bracelet forms are a headline 2026 trend, alongside curated ring stacks.
trends.evidence: Who What Wear lists 'Sculptural Cuffs' as the #1 trend set to define 2026 and 'Chunky Silver' in its UK edit. Pinterest Predicts 2026, via Fine Color Jewels, shows 'gold cuff' searches +50%. Artizan Joyeria's fall 2026 list flags bangles worn over knitwear. Every bracelet in the catalog is a chain or beaded strand, and only three rings exist, so ring stacking is half-covered.
trends.idea: Add a simple silver cuff and expand the ring range so stacking content has product behind it.

trends.name: Natural stones, beading and bug motifs
trends.what: Natural stones, beaded weaving and animal/insect motifs run through FW26/27 and into spring.
trends.evidence: Perles & Co's Fall-Winter 2026-2027 trend guide (~13 Oct 2026) names five trends: vintage, beaded weaving, natural stones, animal motifs and resin, with a burgundy/purple/chartreuse/earth-tone palette. National Jeweler's Pinterest write-up highlights 'Cool Blue'. In Color Magazine summarises Pinterest 2026 jewellery signals as Art Deco nostalgia, brooches, heirloom pieces and bug motifs. The Quality Edit adds colourful gemstones for 2026.
trends.idea: Group turquoise, gemstone and bug-motif pieces into a natural-stone and creatures edit heading into spring.

blogIdeas.why: Stuller's 15 Oct 2026 holiday report names charms among the six biggest holiday 2026 trends, and Google's April 2026 search report (via Our Coordinates) shows 'chunky charm necklace' nearly doubling in a month.
HELLO!, Woman & Home and NET-A-PORTER's PORTER all place silver at the centre of AW26, with Artizan Joyeria reading Google Trends as +60% on the five-year baseline.

blogIdeas.query: what jewellery to wear with a velvet dress
blogIdeas.why: Etsy's Fall/Winter 2026 seller report (16 Oct 2026) names 'Operatic Drama' — rich fabrics with ornate jewellery — as rising for the season.
Etsy's 'Merrymaxxing' trend plus Pinterest Predicts 2026 (maximalist accessories +105% via Fine Color Jewels, 'chunkier and bolder' via JCK) make bold necklaces the party-season story.
Pinterest Predicts 2026 shows heirloom jewellery +45% and 'brooch aesthetic' +110% (National Jeweler, Fine Color Jewels), while Etsy and Perles & Co both name vintage as a FW26/27 pillar.

trends.name: Pearlcore
trends.what: A head-to-toe pearl jewelry aesthetic spanning body chains, bracelets, glasses chains and more.
trends.evidence: Branvas's 2026 Jewelry Trend Map scores pearlcore highest on its Trend Positioning Framework, recommending brands 'Prioritize' it. Marie Claire's 2026 trend report also names 'beads, pearls' among the season's defining looks.
trends.idea: Publish a pearlcore style guide showcasing the shop's existing head-to-toe pearl range.

trends.name: Chunky, bold gold ('80s luxury'/'Glamoratti')
trends.what: Bold, chunky gold jewelry inspired by '80s luxury glamour, including cuffs and statement chains.
trends.evidence: National Jeweler reports Pinterest searches for 'gold cuff' up 50% and ''80s luxury' up 225%. Branvas cites Etsy reporting an 18,000% increase in gold jewelry searches during their Fall/Winter 2025 trend cycle.
trends.idea: Promote existing bold gold chain pieces for the gifting season while flagging cuffs/bangles as a future product gap.

trends.name: Personalized & birthstone rings, including pinky rings
trends.what: Meaningful personalized rings, especially birthstone rings and pinky rings worn as a styling statement.
trends.evidence: Marie Claire's 2026 report lists 'Pinky Rings' as one of seven defining jewelry trends. Artizan Joyeria's ranked list of 2026 women's jewelry trends puts birthstone jewelry in its top five, noting people connect jewelry to identity and memories through birthstones.
trends.idea: Create a dedicated ring styling and meaning guide at the accessible gift price point to capture this rising search demand.

trends.name: Lariat / no-clasp slip necklaces
trends.what: Necklaces that slip on without a clasp, styled in a Y-shape or draping lariat form.
trends.evidence: WhoWhatWear's 2026 'retire these, wear these' guide places lariat necklaces in its 'Investing In' column, crediting indie jewelry brands Le Sundial and Ayllón for the look's rise in popularity.
trends.idea: Write a styling guide on how to wear the shop's lariat necklaces for both day and evening looks.

trends.name: Brooches
trends.what: Decorative pins/brooches making a comeback as a styling accessory.
trends.evidence: National Jeweler reports searches for 'brooch aesthetic' up 110% as part of Pinterest's 2026 forecast, predicting a revival among both younger and older shoppers.
trends.idea: Note this as a future product opportunity since the shop currently sells no pins or brooches.

trends.name: Statement earrings & wide cuffs/bangles
trends.what: Bold statement earrings and rigid wide cuff/bangle bracelets.
trends.evidence: Branvas's trend map scores statement earrings a top 'Prioritize' rating identical to pearlcore, and Artizan Joyeria separately ranks 'Bangles' as the #1 bracelet trend heading into 2026.
trends.idea: Flag this as a structural product gap since the shop sells no earrings or rigid cuffs at all.

blogIdeas.why: Branvas's 2026 Jewelry Trend Map gives pearlcore its top 'Prioritize' score for rising search and conversion, and we already carry the aesthetic across five categories.
National Jeweler reports Pinterest searches for 'gold cuff' up 50% and ''80s luxury' up 225%, while Branvas cites an 18,000% Etsy search spike for gold jewelry.
Marie Claire names pinky rings a defining 2026 trend and Artizan Joyeria ranks birthstone jewelry in its top five for the year.
WhoWhatWear's 2026 trend guide lists lariat necklaces as rising ('Investing In'), crediting indie labels for the look's popularity.

blogIdeas.query: what jewelry to wear with an off the shoulder top
blogIdeas.why: Off-shoulder tops are a recurring cold-weather party silhouette through Christmas/NYE season and this specific garment pairing isn't yet covered.

trends.name: Maximalism: statement pieces and collected-over-time stacks
trends.what: Bold, oversized jewellery and layered 'collected over time' stacks replacing matched minimal sets.
trends.evidence: Trendalytics (16 Apr 2026) reports oversized hoop earrings search up +414% and frames 2026 as 'more is more', citing Saint Laurent and Valentino palm-sized pendants and shoulder-duster earrings plus a 'collected over time' aesthetic. Gabriel & Co (~Sept 2026) lists chunky chains and statement pieces coexisting with minimal everyday pieces, 'the key trend is versatility'. TikTok Discover's Jewelry Trends for 2026 hub (updated 2026-09-28) features Leslie Curtis Jewelry Designs on 'bold statement pieces, mixed metals, layered necklaces' and CROÍA Jewellery's AW26 round-up of 'unconventional jewellery, pops of colour, statement earrings'.
trends.idea: Push the shoulder harnesses, chest chains and layered stacks as party-season statement pieces in styling content.

trends.name: Colour: coloured gemstones, beads and dopamine pieces
trends.what: Vivid coloured stones, beads and chunky 'dopamine' jewellery gaining ground over all-metal looks.
trends.evidence: Trendalytics reports sapphire jewelry up +184%, read as rising demand for colourful statement pieces. McCaskill & Company says fascination with coloured gemstones will be 'stronger than ever in 2026', naming deep sapphires, vivid emeralds and warm citrines in minimal settings. TikTok Discover's 2026 Jewelry Trends hub features Edmonds Jewellers predicting colourful jewellery goes viral in 2026 and whxte atelier saying colour is the biggest trend; the Fashion Trend Jewelry 2026 hub features 'chunky dopamine necklaces' and shell/stone amulets on cord.
missing: coloured belly and body chains beyond metal, pearl and turquoise
trends.idea: Lead winter colour content with birthstone and gemstone pieces, saving beaded beach colour for the spring push.

trends.name: Personalisation, charms and meaning-driven symbols
trends.what: Initials, birthstones, zodiac and celestial symbols replacing uniform matched jewellery.
trends.evidence: A Diamond Is Forever (~Sept 2026) states 'personalization is replacing uniformity', with charms, brooches and mixed-metal pairings letting wearers build layered, story-driven collections instead of matched sets. Gabriel & Co lists 'personalized jewelry and celestial motifs', saying meaning-driven jewellery takes on deeper emotional nuance in 2026. TikTok Discover's 2026 Jewelry Trends hub lists 'meaningful symbols' and 'statement clasps' alongside modular necklaces.
missing: buildable charm systems (sold-separately charms, charm bars, swappable clasps)
trends.idea: Build gifting content around initial, birthstone and zodiac pieces through November and December.

trends.name: Modern pearls (baroque, asymmetric, non-traditional)
trends.what: Pearls styled in organic, irregular and avant-garde ways rather than prim classic strands.
trends.evidence: McCaskill & Company says pearls are back in the spotlight 'but not in the traditional sense', forecasting organic, baroque and asymmetrical pearls used in avant-garde ways. Gabriel & Co lists 'modern pearls' as a core 2026 trend, saying pearls are shedding their prim reputation. fitiny's TikTok round-up (~Aug 2026) names 'coquette pearl-heart combos' as one of four looks defining 2026, with dainty pearl drops and heart motifs.
trends.idea: Reframe our pearl body chains and harnesses as the unconventional, non-prim way to wear pearls this party and bridal season.

trends.name: Sculptural, fluid forms and bold gold cuffs
trends.what: Organic curves, melting shapes and asymmetric silhouettes replacing angular lines, with chunky gold cuffs and statement rings leading.
trends.evidence: Jewelers Mutual says angular lines are taking a back seat to organic forms in both fine and fashion jewellery, with fluid curves and asymmetrical silhouettes 'expected to see mainstream adoption in 2026', naming oval loops, melting shapes and winding gold bands. McCaskill & Company predicts architectural forms and fluid lines, specifically 'bold gold cuffs, oversized hoops, and statement rings'.
trends.idea: Test a small sculptural capsule — a chunky gold cuff and an organic-form pendant — since the closest we have are mirror-link and coin-link pieces.

trends.name: No piercing needed jewellery
trends.what: Low-commitment, high-impact jewellery formats that need no piercing, from magnetic studs to body chains.
trends.evidence: fitiny identifies magnetic non-piercing studs as the defining viral format of 2026, arguing the common thread across every viral aesthetic is 'low commitment, high visual impact', and reports #MenJewelry hit 4.2 billion views in Q1 2026 around a 'no piercing needed' single-stud format.
trends.idea: Claim the 'no piercing needed' language across our body chain range, which is already entirely piercing-free but never says so.

blogIdeas.why: Trend-forecast content is searched Oct–Jan and the 2027 slot is open, writeable off Jewelers Mutual on fluid organic forms, McCaskill on sculptural gold and coloured gemstones, Trendalytics on maximalism (+414% hoops, +184% sapphire) and Gabriel & Co on modern pearls.

trends.evidence: Style press describes the 2026 coquette evolution as confidence in softness, a fusion of girlycore and Old English elegance with balletcore touches, described as peaking on TikTok and Pinterest.
